faq.title: WhatsApp Blue Tick FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers before your business begins the verification process.

items.question: Are the WhatsApp Blue Tick and Green Tick the same?
items.answer: Yes. WhatsApp changed the verified badge from green to blue to align verification signals across Meta products. The purpose remains to identify an authentic, verified business.

items.question: How do I apply for the WhatsApp Blue Tick?
items.answer: Businesses using the WhatsApp Business Platform can request official business account status through the available Meta or solution-provider process. Dealup first checks your readiness and helps organise the submission.

items.question: How long does the review take?
items.answer: Review times vary. Many complete applications receive a response in roughly 7–10 business days, but Meta does not guarantee a fixed timeline.

items.question: What happens if my request is denied?
items.answer: A denial is not necessarily final. Review the gaps, strengthen the evidence, and reapply when the current Meta rules allow another submission.

items.question: Can Dealup guarantee approval?
items.answer: No. Dealup can assess readiness and improve the quality of the application, but only Meta decides whether a business receives or keeps the badge.

items.question: Is the Blue Tick application free?
items.answer: Meta does not normally charge a separate application fee for official business account review through the Business Platform. Platform, onboarding, or support costs may still apply; Dealup confirms the current scope before you begin.

faq.title: Everything you need to know about WhatsApp Forms

items.question: What is a WhatsApp Form?
items.answer: An interactive form that opens inside the WhatsApp conversation itself. Instead of sending someone to a landing page, you collect what you need — details, a booking, an order, feedback — without them ever leaving the chat.

items.question: Can I use conditional questions?
items.answer: Yes. A form can branch on an answer, so a customer only sees the questions that apply to them and skips the ones that do not.

items.question: How is a submission handled?
items.answer: It arrives in the same conversation thread, attached to that contact, with the answers stored as fields rather than loose text. From there you can assign it, tag it, reply, or push it onward automatically.

items.question: Is a form better than a link to my website?
items.answer: Usually. A link asks someone to leave WhatsApp, load a page and start again, and a good share of people stop there. A form keeps them in the app they already had open, which is why completion tends to be higher.

items.question: Can I connect it to my CRM?
items.answer: Yes. Responses can be pushed to your CRM or any other system through our integrations, webhooks and API, so a submission becomes a record without anyone retyping it.

items.question: Do forms work with Click-to-WhatsApp ads?
items.answer: Yes. Someone taps your ad, the chat opens, and the form can appear straight away — so the lead is captured and qualified in the same moment they arrive.

items.question: Can I manage multiple client accounts?
items.answer: Yes. Each client gets their own workspace with separate conversations, campaigns and analytics — all accessible from a single agency dashboard. There's no limit on the number of client accounts.

items.question: Do my clients see each other's data?
items.answer: No. Each workspace is completely isolated. Clients only see their own data, conversations and campaigns. Your agency dashboard aggregates performance across all clients for your internal view.

items.question: Can I white-label the platform for clients?
items.answer: Reports and dashboards can be exported with your agency branding. Client-facing views show the Dealup platform, but all reporting is customizable with your logo and colors.

items.question: How does AI work across multiple clients?
items.answer: AI learns each client's brand voice independently. When you draft a campaign for Client A, it uses A's tone and style. Switch to Client B and the AI adapts accordingly.

items.question: Is there a limit on campaigns per client?
items.answer: No limits on campaigns, broadcasts or automations per client. You can run as many campaigns as needed across your entire portfolio.

items.question: Can clients access their own dashboard?
items.answer: Yes. You can invite clients to view their own workspace with read-only access. They see their conversations, campaign results and analytics without accessing other clients or your agency settings.
